info.title: Hotel Price API
info.description:
# HotelPlus Rate Intelligence Platform API

Sentinel Core Engine providing:
- Real-time and scheduled competitor price intelligence.
- Semantic search using vector embeddings and PostgreSQL pgvector.
- Otonom reasoning and decision analysis using Gemini models.
- Deep market yield analysis and rate parity logs.

### Compliance & Security
- Rate-limited endpoints for system stability.
- Zero PII footprint in accordance with GDPR & CCPA scope exclusion.
- All requests are logged and monitored under strict Row-Level Security (RLS).

get.description:
GDPR Article 15 / KVKK Article 11 — Data Subject Access Request (Export).

Returns a comprehensive JSON export of all personal data the platform
holds for the authenticated user. Includes profile, settings, hotel
associations, and alerts. Excludes aggregated pricing/scan data which
is classified as business intelligence.

delete.description:
GDPR Article 17 / KVKK Article 7 — Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten").

Permanently deletes all personal data for the authenticated user:
  - Anonymizes scan_sessions and query_logs (preserves business intelligence)
  - Hard deletes alerts, user_hotels, settings, and user_profiles
  - Removes the InsForge/Supabase auth record

⚠️  This action is IRREVERSIBLE. The user's session will be invalidated
after this call completes.

post.description:
GDPR Article 7 / KVKK Article 5 — Consent Recording.

Records the user's explicit consent (or withdrawal) with a server-side
timestamp in the user_profiles table. This provides an auditable trail
for regulatory compliance.

Fire-and-forget: never raises 500 for non-critical DB failures.

get.description:
Ghost Competitor Discovery — Semantic Vector Search (B2B Cold Start Solver).

Automatically identifies hotels that are semantically similar to the target
hotel using pgvector cosine similarity on Gemini-generated hotel embeddings.

This route is called automatically when a hotel has fewer than 2 configured
competitors, providing instant "Suggested Competitors" without any manual
configuration by the hotelier.

Unlike /v1/discovery/{hotel_id} (SerpAPI real-time search), this route:
- Is instantaneous (no external API calls once embeddings exist)
- Works offline from OTA data
- Improves over time as more hotels are embedded in the directory

Returns hotels ranked by semantic similarity (descending).

schema.title: Response Discover Ghost Competitors Semantic Api V1 Discovery  Hotel Id  Semantic Get

Batch signal ingestion endpoint.

Receives up to 100 dashboard interaction signals per call from the
useSignalBuffer React hook.  Signals are stored in user_signals and
the CompsetIntelligenceAgent is scheduled as a background task when
the user has accumulated enough events (≥ 5 within the last hour).

Signal types expected:
- competitor_click / competitor_expand / competitor_tab_selected
- alert_investigated / alert_dismissed
- dwell_time / view / click
